name: pw-measures
label: Numbered measures
description: Section with label, rule, headline, intro, a ruled numbered list (numbers are automatic) and an italic closing line.

defaults.closing: These are the hardest measures there are.
defaults.headline: Success is measured in relationship.
defaults.intro: Power With offers five measures. Read them slowly. Notice which one stays with you.

items.text: The safety people feel in your presence.
The willingness of others to tell you what is actually happening.
The quality of your attention when others speak.
Your willingness to repair when you have caused harm.
The depth of connection you sustain over time.

template:
{{#if kicker}}

{{kicker}}

{{/if}}

{{headline}}

{{#if intro}}

{{intro}}

{{/if}}
    {{#each items}}
  1. {{text}}
    2. {{/each}}
{{#if closing}}

{{closing}}

{{/if}}

ai.purpose: Numbered list of measures with automatic numbering.
ai.whenToUse: Short ruled lists of statements that should read slowly.
